scripts.dev: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run types && wrangler dev --local --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run types && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm run migrations:check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.check: pnpm run migrations:check && pnpm run types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm run build
